title: GigaChat 3.5 Reasoning open weights and hybrid MLA architecture release
summary: Sber released open weights for GigaChat3.5-432B-A28B-Reasoning on Hugging Face, introducing a 432B mixture-of-experts model with 28B active parameters, alternating Multi-head Latent Attention and GatedDeltaNet layers, and a 262K context window.
research_notes:
Deploy GigaChat3.5-432B-A28B-Reasoning using vLLM or SGLang inference engines with FP8 quantization and multi-GPU tensor parallelism supporting Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and GatedDeltaNet layers.

Configure inference runtime parameters to leverage the native 262K token context window and activate multi-token prediction heads for speculative decoding acceleration.

Utilize low-rank Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) Key-Value cache compression in combination with alternating linear attention layers to prevent memory exhaustion during long-context generation.

Provision distributed enterprise hardware clusters with sufficient aggregate VRAM to host the 432B parameter weights despite sparse 28B active routing per token.
